title.zh: 音色盘大补：十一个缺口、弦乐连奏、编排器的六处缺口
title.en: The palette refilled: eleven gaps, string legato, and the editor's six missing pieces

highlights.zh: 十三个乐器缺口填上十一个（另两个按独立依据排除）；弦乐四类演奏法入库；新预算用满到 99.78%——两条候选是量过之后不买的。
highlights.en: Eleven of thirteen instrument gaps are filled, the last two excluded on stated grounds; the four string techniques land; and the new budget reaches ninety-nine point eight percent, with two candidates declined after measurement.

highlights.zh: 「弓没停过的重叠」现在是连奏：落在还在响的和弦上的起音 57 → 25，同一条规则也接到实时两条路与工具回复。
highlights.en: An overlap the bow never stopped is now a legato, taking attacks on a sounding chord from fifty-seven to twenty-five, and the same rule now reaches both live paths and the tool reply.

highlights.zh: 新编排器补齐：撤销/重做、工程命名与持久化、导出菜单与导入入口、导入 MIDI 时指定乐器、顶栏工程名。
highlights.en: The new editor gains undo and redo, project naming and persistence, its export menu and import entry, an instrument choice on MIDI import, and the project name in the header.
